decisions.reason: The formwork profile system sits close to the core offer and still had its own page in 2019, so it costs little to keep and remains a useful option alongside the firm's integrated formwork business.
The shuttering magnet block is a low-cost consumable that complements the core business and was still listed in 2019, so dropping it brings little benefit despite the thin evidence on its results.
This magnetic formwork component kept a dedicated page through 2019, which signals that the firm is committed to it, and it costs little to keep within the existing product line.

This component was only mentioned on the website and the related magnetic strips were already dropped, so it is somewhat more exposed to pruning, but it is cheap to hold and close to the core offer, so the option stays open.
